public_rationale: Marcus predicted many more reports of brittle, failing agents through 2025. Such reports appeared all year. In April, Tom's Guide documented ChatGPT Tasks scheduling failures. In May, Salesforce researchers reported a substantial gap between agent abilities and enterprise needs. In June, Reuters carried Gartner's view that current models lack the maturity to follow nuanced instructions. In July, outlets widely covered Replit's agent erasing a production database. These are different kinds of reports, spread across the year, so the forecast held.
limitations: No exact count of reports; 'many, many' is judged qualitatively.
The sample cited is illustrative, not exhaustive.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Throughout 2025 there will be many more reports of AI agents being brittle and failing.

statement.excerpt: We can safely expect many, many more reports like these throughout the year, akin to the endless and still ongoing reports of hallucinations over the last couple years.
statement.document_title: AI Agents: Hype versus Reality, redux

from_speaker: many, many more reports like these
akin to the endless ... reports of hallucinations
our_interpretation: 'Reports like these' means public reports that AI agents are brittle or fail at real tasks.
Plain reading: many such reports would appear across 2025, from news, benchmarks and analysts, not just a few.
Horizon: post date to the end of 2025.
criteria.support_condition: Numerous public reports, spread across 2025, document agent failures or brittleness.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Few or no such reports appear in 2025, or reports mainly describe agents working reliably.
